```{r overview_ui}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

# Safely extract base sequences from whichever data successfully loaded
all_seqs <- character()
if (exists("motu_df") && nrow(motu_df) > 0) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, motu_df$query_id)
if (exists("summary_bold_df") && nrow(summary_bold_df) > 0) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, summary_bold_df$query_id)
if (exists("summary_blast_df") && nrow(summary_blast_df) > 0) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, summary_blast_df$query_title)

overview_df <- tibble(query_id = unique(all_seqs))

# Merge BOLD top hits if available
if (exists("summary_bold_df") && nrow(summary_bold_df) > 0) {
  overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(
    overview_df,
    summary_bold_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        query_id,
        BOLD_QC = qc_symbol,
        BOLD_QC_Class = qc_sym_class,
        BOLD_QC_Reason = qc_reason,
        BOLD_ID = top_id,
        BOLD_Hit = hit_id
      ),
    by = "query_id"
  )
}

# Merge Distance MOTUs as a factor for exact-match MOTU filtering
if (exists("motu_df") && nrow(motu_df) > 0) {
  motu_clean <- motu_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(query_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(motu = factor(motu))
  overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(overview_df, motu_clean, by = "query_id")
}

# Merge additional S7 report overview columns if provided
if (exists("extra_reports_list") && length(extra_reports_list) > 0) {
  for (rep_obj in extra_reports_list) {
    key_col <- rep_obj@col_key
    ov_cols <- rep_obj@col_overview
    if (!is.null(key_col) && nzchar(key_col) && length(ov_cols) > 0) {
      valid_cols <- intersect(ov_cols, names(rep_obj@data))
      if (length(valid_cols) > 0 && key_col %in% names(rep_obj@data)) {
        sub_ov <- rep_obj@data %>%
          dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(key_col, valid_cols))) %>%
          dplyr::rename(query_id = dplyr::all_of(key_col)) %>%
          dplyr::distinct(query_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
        overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(overview_df, sub_ov, by = "query_id")
      }
    }
  }
}

# Merge User Metadata if provided (preserving numeric vs factor vs character types)
if (!is.null(params$metadata_path) && nzchar(params$metadata_path) &&
    !is.null(params$key_col) && nzchar(params$key_col)) {
  user_meta <- readRDS(params$metadata_path)
  if (params$key_col %in% names(user_meta)) {
    user_meta <- user_meta %>%
      dplyr::rename(query_id = dplyr::all_of(params$key_col)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(query_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
    overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(overview_df, user_meta, by = "query_id")
  }
}

# Helper to link MOTU cluster to Intra-MOTU Genetic Distance section
generate_motu_link <- function(value) {
  val_chr <- as.character(value)
  if (is.na(val_chr) || !nzchar(val_chr)) return("-")
  anchor_id <- paste0("motu-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "-", val_chr))
  sprintf(
    '<a href="#%s" class="bold-link motu-jump-link" data-motu-anchor="%s" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); jumpToMotu(\'%s\');" style="color: var(--tbl-accent); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600;">%s</a>',
    anchor_id, anchor_id, anchor_id, htmlEscape(val_chr)
  )
}

# Range filter for numeric columns
numeric_range_filter_method <- JS("
  function(rows, columnId, filterValue) {
    if (!filterValue || String(filterValue).trim() === '') return rows;
    var raw = String(filterValue).trim();
    var minVal = -Infinity;
    var maxVal = Infinity;

    var rangeMatch = raw.match(/^(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)\\s*(?:-|\\.\\.|to|,)\\s*(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)$/i);
    if (rangeMatch) {
      minVal = parseFloat(rangeMatch[1]);
      maxVal = parseFloat(rangeMatch[2]);
    } else if (/^>=\\s*(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)$/.test(raw)) { minVal = parseFloat(raw.replace(/^>=\\s*/, '')); } else if (/^<=\\s*(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)$/.test(raw)) {
      maxVal = parseFloat(raw.replace(/^<=\\s*/, ''));
    } else if (/^>\\s*(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)$/.test(raw)) { var gt = parseFloat(raw.replace(/^>\\s*/, '')); return rows.filter(function(r) { var v = Number(r.values[columnId]); return !isNaN(v) && v > gt; }); } else if (/^<\\s*(-?\\d*\\.?\\d+)$/.test(raw)) {
      var lt = parseFloat(raw.replace(/^<\\s*/, ''));
      return rows.filter(function(r) {
        var v = Number(r.values[columnId]);
        return !isNaN(v) && v < lt;
      });
    } else if (!isNaN(parseFloat(raw))) {
      return rows.filter(function(r) {
        var v = Number(r.values[columnId]);
        return !isNaN(v) && String(v).indexOf(raw) !== -1;
      });
    } else {
      return rows;
    }

    return rows.filter(function(r) {
      var v = r.values[columnId];
      if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return false;
      var num = Number(v);
      return !isNaN(num) && num >= minVal && num <= maxVal;
    });
  }
")

numeric_range_filter_input <- JS("
  function(column, state) {
    return React.createElement('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: column.filterValue || '',
      placeholder: 'min - max',
      title: 'Filter range (e.g. 10 - 25, >= 15, <= 50)',
      onChange: function(e) { column.setFilter(e.target.value || undefined); },
      style: {
        width: '100%',
        padding: '4px 6px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--tbl-bg)',
        color: 'var(--tbl-text)',
        border: '1px solid var(--tbl-border)',
        borderRadius: '4px',
        fontSize: '12px'
      }
    });
  }
")

# Exact-match multi-value filter for factor columns (comma-separated tokens)
factor_exact_filter_method <- JS("
  function(rows, columnId, filterValue) {
    if (!filterValue || String(filterValue).trim() === '') return rows;
    var targets = String(filterValue)
      .split(',')
      .map(function(s) { return s.trim(); })
      .filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });
    if (targets.length === 0) return rows;

    return rows.filter(function(r) {
      var v = r.values[columnId];
      if (v === null || v === undefined) return false;
      return targets.indexOf(String(v)) !== -1;
    });
  }
")

# Factor filter input: text input (comma-separated) + dropdown picker that toggles/adds levels
make_factor_filter_input <- function(col_name, col_vec) {
  lvls <- if (is.factor(col_vec)) {
    unique(c(levels(col_vec), as.character(col_vec)))
  } else {
    as.character(col_vec)
  }
  lvls <- sort(unique(lvls[!is.na(lvls) & nzchar(lvls)]))
  escaped_lvls <- gsub("'", "\\\\'", lvls)

  opts_js <- paste0(
    "React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, '+ Add level...'), ",
    paste0("React.createElement('option', { value: '", escaped_lvls, "' }, '", escaped_lvls, "')", collapse = ", ")
  )

  JS(paste0(
    "function(column, state) {\n",
    "  var currentVal = column.filterValue || '';\n",
    "  var addLevel = function(lvl) {\n",
    "    if (!lvl) return;\n",
    "    var parts = currentVal ? currentVal.split(',').map(function(x) { return x.trim(); }).filter(Boolean) : [];\n",
    "    var idx = parts.indexOf(lvl);\n",
    "    if (idx === -1) { parts.push(lvl); } else { parts.splice(idx, 1); }\n",
    "    column.setFilter(parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(', ') : undefined);\n",
    "  };\n",
    "  return React.createElement('div', { style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '3px', width: '100%' } },\n",
    "    React.createElement('input', {\n",
    "      type: 'text',\n",
    "      value: currentVal,\n",
    "      placeholder: 'val1, val2 (exact)',\n",
    "      title: 'Exact match; separate multiple values with commas (e.g. A, B)',\n",
    "      onChange: function(e) { column.setFilter(e.target.value || undefined); },\n",
    "      style: {\n",
    "        width: '100%',\n",
    "        padding: '3px 6px',\n",
    "        backgroundColor: 'var(--tbl-bg)',\n",
    "        color: 'var(--tbl-text)',\n",
    "        border: '1px solid var(--tbl-border)',\n",
    "        borderRadius: '4px',\n",
    "        fontSize: '11px'\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }),\n",
    "    React.createElement('select', {\n",
    "      value: '',\n",
    "      onChange: function(e) { addLevel(e.target.value); e.target.value = ''; },\n",
    "      style: {\n",
    "        width: '100%',\n",
    "        padding: '2px 4px',\n",
    "        backgroundColor: 'var(--tbl-bg)',\n",
    "        color: 'var(--tbl-text)',\n",
    "        border: '1px solid var(--tbl-border)',\n",
    "        borderRadius: '4px',\n",
    "        fontSize: '11px'\n",
    "      }\n",
    "    }, ", opts_js, ")\n",
    "  );\n",
    "}"
  ))
}

# Pure character string filter (substring match)
character_text_filter_input <- JS("
  function(column, state) {
    return React.createElement('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: column.filterValue || '',
      placeholder: 'Contains text...',
      onChange: function(e) { column.setFilter(e.target.value || undefined); },
      style: {
        width: '100%',
        padding: '4px 6px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--tbl-bg)',
        color: 'var(--tbl-text)',
        border: '1px solid var(--tbl-border)',
        borderRadius: '4px',
        fontSize: '12px'
      }
    });
  }
")

# Build column definitions dynamically based on R types
overview_col_defs <- list()

for (cname in names(overview_df)) {
  col_vec <- overview_df[[cname]]

  if (cname == "query_id") {
    overview_df[[cname]] <- as.character(col_vec)
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
      name = "Sequence Name",
      minWidth = 180,
      sticky = "left",
      style = list(fontWeight = 600),
      filterInput = character_text_filter_input
    )
  } else if (cname == "BOLD_ID") {
    overview_df[[cname]] <- as.character(col_vec)
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
      name = "BOLD Result",
      minWidth = 180,
      filterInput = character_text_filter_input,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) return("-")
        if (value == "No Hit") {
          htmltools::span(style = "color: #e06c75; font-style: italic;", value)
        } else {
          htmltools::span(style = "font-weight: 600;", value)
        }
      }
    )
  } else if (cname == "BOLD_Hit" && exists("generate_bold_link")) {
    overview_df[[cname]] <- as.character(col_vec)
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
      name = "BOLD Hit",
      minWidth = 240,
      html = TRUE,
      cell = generate_bold_link,
      filterInput = character_text_filter_input
    )
  } else if (cname == "motu") {
    if (!is.factor(col_vec)) overview_df[[cname]] <- factor(col_vec)
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
      name = "MOTU Cluster",
      minWidth = 150,
      html = TRUE,
      cell = generate_motu_link,
      filterMethod = factor_exact_filter_method,
      filterInput = make_factor_filter_input(cname, overview_df[[cname]])
    )
  } else if (is.numeric(col_vec)) {
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
      minWidth = 120,
      align = "right",
      filterMethod = numeric_range_filter_method,
      filterInput = numeric_range_filter_input,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value) || is.nan(value)) "-" else format(value, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
      }
    )
  } else if (is.factor(col_vec)) {
    overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
        minWidth = 150,
        filterMethod = factor_exact_filter_method,
        filterInput = make_factor_filter_input(cname, col_vec),
        cell = function(value) {
            val_chr <- as.character(value)
            if (is.na(val_chr) || !nzchar(val_chr)) "-" else val_chr
        }
    )
    } else if (cname == "BOLD_QC") {
        overview_df[[cname]] <- as.character(col_vec)
        overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
            name = "",
            width = 28,
            minWidth = 28,
            maxWidth = 28,
            align = "center",
            sortable = FALSE,
            filterable = FALSE,
            style = list(padding = "4px 2px", backgroundColor = "transparent"),
            cell = function(value, index) {
                sym <- if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) "-" else value
                cls <- if ("BOLD_QC_Class" %in% names(overview_df)) overview_df$BOLD_QC_Class[index] else ""
                rsn <- if ("BOLD_QC_Reason" %in% names(overview_df)) overview_df$BOLD_QC_Reason[index] else ""
                htmltools::tags$span(
                    class = trimws(paste("qc-badge qc-symbol", cls)),
                    `data-reason` = if (is.na(rsn)) "" else rsn,
                    sym
                )
            }
        )
    } else if (cname %in% c("BOLD_QC_Class", "BOLD_QC_Reason")) {
        overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(show = FALSE)
    } else if (is.numeric(col_vec)) {
    # Character or other non-factor/non-numeric -> pure character string filter
        overview_df[[cname]] <- as.character(col_vec)
        overview_col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
            minWidth = 140,
            filterInput = character_text_filter_input,
            cell = function(value) {
                    if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) "-" else value
            }
        )
    }
}

htmltools::div(
    style = "display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-bottom: 8px;",
    htmltools::tags$button(
        type = "button",
        onclick = "resetOverviewTable()",
        style = paste(
        "padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;",
        "border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border);",
        "background-color: var(--tbl-stripe); color: var(--tbl-text);"
        ),
        "Reset Filters & Sort"
    )
)

overview_cols_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(names(overview_df), auto_unbox = FALSE)

reactable(
    overview_df,
    elementId = "overview-table",
    theme = dynamic_theme,
    highlight = TRUE,
    striped = FALSE,
    sortable = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 50,
    style = list(fontSize = "13px"),
    columns = overview_col_defs
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
function jumpToMotu(anchorId) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link, [role="tab"]').forEach(function(el) {
    if (el.textContent && el.textContent.trim() === "Genetic Distance") {
      el.click();
    }
  });
  setTimeout(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link, [role="tab"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (el.textContent && el.textContent.trim() === "Intra-MOTU Genetic Distance") {
        el.click();
      }
    });
    var target = document.getElementById(anchorId);
    if (target) {
      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }
  }, 80);
}
window.__overviewAllCols = `r overview_cols_json`;

function resetOverviewTable() {
  if (!window.Reactable) return;
  var tblId = "overview-table";
  var colIds = Array.isArray(window.__overviewAllCols) ? window.__overviewAllCols : [];

  if (typeof Reactable.setAllFilters === "function") {
    Reactable.setAllFilters(tblId, []);
  }
  colIds.forEach(function(cid) {
    try {
      if (typeof Reactable.setFilter === "function") {
        Reactable.setFilter(tblId, cid, undefined);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  });

  try {
    if (typeof Reactable.setSort === "function") {
      Reactable.setSort(tblId, []);
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  var tableEl = document.getElementById(tblId);
  if (tableEl) {
    tableEl.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(function(inp) {
      inp.value = "";
    });
    tableEl.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(function(sel) {
      sel.selectedIndex = 0;
    });
  }
}
</script>
```
